description: Search the aipatterns.com.au AI pattern library. Returns matching patterns with slug, title, description, maturity level, and category. Useful for finding design patterns relevant to a specific AI use case, capability, or compliance concern.

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. agentic-ai, governance, security, rag, observability, compliance, human-in-the-loop)

maturity.description: Optional maturity filter (e.g. production, beta, experimental)

query.description: Search term to match against pattern title, description, or content

name: search_patterns
